name: interferon regulatory factor 4
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IRF4 encodes interferon regulatory factor 4. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to combined immunodeficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: IRF4 encodes interferon regulatory factor 4. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Functional annotations also associate the protein with transcription coactivator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with combined immunodeficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving IRF4 have been reported in large b-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement, malignant lymphoma, and plasma cell myeloma.
